Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly consolidated “Cantora 1” and “Cantora 2” (both listed separately as studio albums in 2009 on the Wikipedia page) into a single album, leading to an undercount. Despite WebSurfer retrieving three qualifying entries (2005 Corazón Libre; 2009 Cantora 1; 2009 Cantora 2), the Planner treated the two 2009 releases as one “double-album” and prematurely concluded the task with the wrong total.
